pk.context: 1 mcg/kg intravenous, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: clear, colourless solution in a single-dose glass bottle

tell: A 6-minute distribution half-life and a 2-hour terminal half-life set this alpha-2 agonist apart.

clues.text: Given intravenously, it is about 94% bound to plasma protein. Almost all of it is biotransformed, through glucuronidation and cytochrome P450 metabolism.
A hydrochloride salt, with a molecular weight of 200.28 for the active base.
Approved under an NDA in 200 mcg and 400 mcg sizes at 4 mcg per mL, infused for no more than 24 hours.
No boxed warning, and no contraindications are listed. Hypotension, bradycardia and dry mouth are the most common reactions in adults.
Sedation of intubated adults in intensive care, and of non-intubated adults and children before or during procedures.
A relatively selective, centrally acting alpha-2 agonist; at high doses, alpha-1 activity also appears.
The generic name begins with D and has fifteen letters.
